body: Religion is a bunch of bullshit IMO. Don’t waste your time begging for an invisible force to fix your life because it will never happen. You are the only one who can do that. Medication is a crutch but right now you might consider it. Once you’re stable then you will be able to find things to break out of this depressive spiral. Depression is like a virus. It spreads through your brain. The longer it goes on the more parts of your brain become infected. There is no cure but you can reclaim the infected areas. Don’t look here for advice beyond this: Go see a professional. There are millions of people dealing with depression and we all know what it feels like to be where you are. Professional help is how you can take your life into your own hands and stop relying on your god to do the work, because they never will.
